name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1908: v1907 shipped REG-204 with journal_tab in the conflict set and that was wrong, caught in the review pass twenty minutes later before any sweep ran against it. The journal sticky says what it is in its own docstring - last deep tab HELD until the next deep tab or 25 seconds - so it is a lagging signal by construction, and for up to 25 seconds after he clicks from Runes to Gems the sticky still says runes while the OCR correctly reads gems. v1907 treated that as a contradiction and demoted an ordinary tab switch to a generic stash with no tally, trading a regression on something he does constantly against a contradiction measured at zero of 68 frames. I widened the set past the evidence that justified it. Also pinned: the conflict marker cannot be mistaken for an OCR witness downstream, and the claude lane crop path is now driven, because every existing chronicle test runs under TV_STUB and returns before the crop is reached.
